# Welile

> Africa's rent facilitation platform. Access rent today and pay it back over time, fund verified tenants for steady returns, and manage everything from your phone.

Welile connects tenants, landlords, agents, and funders. Tenants get help paying rent and build a trust profile; funders earn managed returns by supporting verified tenants; landlords list properties and receive guaranteed rent.

## Pages

- [Welcome](/welcome): Explore housing and funding opportunities across Africa.
- [Rent Money](/rent-money): Digital wallet to deposit, send, withdraw, and pay rent on MTN & Airtel Mobile Money.
- [Find a House](/find-a-house): Browse verified homes available for rent near you.
- [Opportunities](/opportunities): Discover funding and earning opportunities on Welile.
- [Become a Funder](/funder-onboarding): Fund verified tenants and grow your capital with managed returns.
- [Become a Partner](/partner-onboarding): Partner with Welile to expand housing access.
- [Internship](/internship): Join the Welile internship program to learn, earn, and grow.
